mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a refrigerator water line in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install a refrigerator water line in the Las Vegas area can vary depending on several factors, such as the distance from the existing water supply to the refrigerator, the type of flooring, and whether a new shut-off valve is needed. More complex installations requiring extensive routing or modifications to existing plumbing will typically incur higher costs.
